description.value: Rhino Coffee House is a surf-culture café anchored in Tofino's downtown core, serving espresso drinks, handcrafted matcha lattes, and a rotating lineup of fresh-baked goods including their signature savory 'Bro Nut' stuffed donut. The menu spans hearty all-day breakfasts and lunch sandwiches — pastrami on rye, triple grilled cheese, BBQ chicken — alongside a dedicated vegan menu and gluten-friendly options. Built around Tofino's outdoor lifestyle, the café actively markets itself as a pre-surf and post-hike refuel destination, with a takeout program specifically designed for beach days and trail runs.
